lines: Yo! Ozzie. You skate? You totally should. The Big Vert's huge. I've dropped in once. Okay, half once. I sat down halfway.
I got zero apples. ZERO. The barrel's rigged. Hank's rigged it.
Next year I'm bringing a snorkel.
Watch this! (Ozzie kickflips. Lands it. Looks very surprised.) Did you see that?! Nobody ever sees that!
Recess. No boards allowed at school. I'm practising in my head.

rotate: Bruno's the best skater in town. Don't tell him I said that. His head's big enough with the beanie on.
There's a rail all the way down Lookout Hill. Take the kicker at the bottom and you go SO high. Like, bird high.
Hank says I can use his loading dock if I don't scare the pigeons. The pigeons scare me.
